title: Fill in a Triton softmax
summary: One program per row, a mask for the tail, and the max, exp and sum in registers.
text:
@triton.jit
def softmax_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, n_cols, stride, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
    row = tl.[[b1]](0)
    cols = tl.[[b2]](0, BLOCK)
    mask = cols [[b3]] n_cols
    x = tl.load(x_ptr + row * stride + cols, mask=mask, other=[[b4]])
    x = x - tl.[[b5]](x, axis=0)
    num = tl.exp(x)
    y = num / tl.[[b6]](num, axis=0)
    tl.store(y_ptr + row * stride + cols, y, mask=mask)
